capabilities: add leaf-id and filename parameters to the URI protocol
switch between open tabs from Rofi
generate tab lists via an included Python script
extras: Tested only on Linux; the sample script requires editing vault name variables, making it executable, and placing it in the system PATH.
problem: Obsidian's URI protocol has no parameter for targeting a specific open tab, so external launchers cannot switch tabs directly.
summary: URI protocol extension that adds leaf-id and filename parameters so Rofi can switch between open Obsidian tabs.
